name: content-publish-approval
description: Collect draft content details via form, gate on editorial approval, then emit a publish record.

steps.description: Editor must approve the content before it is published.
steps.prompt: Review the draft content details collected in the previous step. Approve to publish, or reject if the content needs revision.

steps.run:
set -o pipefail; jq -r '
  if (((."editorial-approval".decision) // "reject") | tostring) == "approve" then
    "## Publish Record — APPROVED\n" +
    "**Title:** " + ((."collect-draft".title // "(untitled)") | tostring) + "\n" +
    "**Channel:** " + ((."collect-draft".channel // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
    "**Decision:** approve\n" +
    "**Publisher:** " + ((.inputs.publisher // "Content Team") | tostring)
  else
    "## Publish Record — REJECTED (not published)\n" +
    "**Title:** " + ((."collect-draft".title // "(untitled)") | tostring) + "\n" +
    "**Channel:** " + ((."collect-draft".channel // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
    "**Decision:** reject\n" +
    "Do NOT publish — editorial approval was rejected."
  end
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{publish_record: .}'
